identification.summary: CrowdStrike tracks Clever Kitten as an Iran-based adversary that mainly targets global companies seen as strategically important to countries that oppose Iranian interests [S1]. Its tradecraft centers on web-server attacks, with a strong affinity for PHP server-side attacks, which is relatively unusual among targeted attackers who often rely on social engineering [S1].
identification.firstObserved: 2013; CrowdStrike's 'Who is Clever Kitten' post is dated April 2013 per search results. Exact first-activity date is unverified.
identification.notes: Secondary aggregator listings give the alias Group41 [S2]; the name also appears in MISP galaxy synonyms alongside Cutting Kitten/APT35, so it may be ambiguous. No Cisco Talos report was found supporting a Talos link. Clever Kitten is distinct from other Iranian groups CrowdStrike tracks, such as Helix Kitten [S1].

attribution.sponsor: Iran (Islamic Republic of Iran), per CrowdStrike's assessment [S1]. No specific Iranian government organization is named in the sources gathered.
attribution.confidence: CrowdStrike states it links the group to the Islamic Republic of Iran based on several indicators; no confidence level is given in the material retrieved [S1].
attribution.basis: CrowdStrike cites unspecified indicators linking the group to Iran [S1]. The individual indicators were not retrievable.

objectives: Information theft and espionage against companies strategically important to states opposed to Iranian interests [S1][S2].

targeting.notes: CrowdStrike describes targets only as global companies of strategic importance to countries that are contrary to Iranian interests [S1]. No sector or country list was found in retrievable sources.

capabilities.summary: Attacks typically begin with a web vulnerability scanner for reconnaissance; CrowdStrike identified it as the commercial Acunetix Web Vulnerability Scanner [S1]. After finding an exploitable page, the actor uploads a PHP backdoor for remote access [S1].

diamond.adversary: Iran-based actor tracked by CrowdStrike as Clever Kitten [S1].
diamond.capability: Acunetix scanning followed by PHP web-shell upload; commercial and public tooling [S1].
diamond.victim: Global companies of strategic importance to countries opposed to Iranian interests [S1].
diamond.socioPolitical: Espionage serving Iranian interests against adversary-aligned states' strategically important companies [S1].
diamond.technology: Internet-facing PHP web applications and web servers with exploitable pages [S1].

gaps: The CrowdStrike page itself was not fetched; content derives from search excerpts. Post date April 2013 per search results.
No Cisco Talos report for 'Group 41' was found; the alias rests on aggregator listings only and may be ambiguous.
No dated campaigns, victims, sectors, countries, infrastructure, or malware beyond Acunetix and a PHP web shell were found.

No evidence of recent activity (post-2013) was found; the actor may be dormant, renamed, or merged into other tracking. Overlap with other Iranian clusters (for example CopyKittens/Slayer Kitten) is not established by any source and must not be assumed.
No MITRE ATT&CK group or Microsoft Threat Actor name mapping was identified.
